[[Valetudo Rubor]] is a [[Titan]] [[ranger]] [[boss]] in [[Hell's Precipice]].

== Locations ==
* [[Ring of Fire Islands]]
** {{NPC location|Hell's Precipice}}

== Skills ==
16 [[Wilderness Survival]]
* {{skill icon|Flame Trap}}
* {{skill icon|Greater Conflagration}} ([[elite]])
* {{skill icon|Troll Unguent}}

== Items dropped ==   
* [[Titan Armor]]

== Notes ==
* Despite being a Ranger, this boss uses melee attacks.
* Shares his spawn point with [[Tortitudo Probo]], [[Maligo Libens]], [[Moles Quibus]] and [[Scelus Prosum]].
* All five bosses spawn in the four locations shown. The two western locations are really one large area with three bosses. The other two spawn points have a single boss each.
* In the western spawn points, one boss can be seen patrolling while the other two will spawn out of the lava after about 5 minutes.

== Trivia ==
* Could be freely translated from Latin as "Red Weakness".
* [[w:Vale tudo|Vale tudo]] describes competitions in unarmed combat having minimal rules.
